sections.heading: File System — the Explorer, in the app
sections.body:
The File System Explorer, in the app.

This pocket carries the Explorer built 2026-10-19 under commission FILE-SYSTEM-20261019: pockets shown as tiles, containers as tiles with what's inside them, a breadcrumb to walk back up, search in the folder you're standing in, an Add picker, and real drag — pull a tile onto a folder tile and it moves in. Your grid profile is in there too: Solid or Spaced.

It was built in the workshop and verified there (walked headlessly, zero errors, drag proven). It sat in the workshop overnight instead of being put where you look — that miss is the Manager's, recorded here because this pocket is where the record belongs.

HONEST STATE: the Explorer below runs on a snapshot — 45 real pockets pulled 2026-10-18, the real tree at that moment. Dragging and adding work inside the page; they do not save back to the app yet. Wiring it to live state is the next step, on your word. The tiles' covers are plain gradients for now — real faces are the separate pass already moving through the app.
